Source & comparison

Source: sample CSV, H1 2026. 194 + 194 + 72 + 20 = 480 customers. $3.15M ÷ $1.53M ≈ 2.06, so “more than twice” is a derived comparison.

Fictional test data

Implication

The strongest signal is not growth alone—it is growth with improving quality.

Mid-Market is the revenue engine, while conversion and retention gains across every segment make the expansion broad-based within this limited dataset.

Scale: derived revenue +40%; customers +28%.

Driver: Mid-Market contributed 51% of the revenue increase.

Quality: all eight H1-to-H1 rate comparisons improved.

Limit: three half-year periods do not establish a long-term forecast.

Source & caution

Source: sample CSV. This is a fictional testing artifact. Conclusions are descriptive of the supplied H1 2025–H1 2026 data only; no causation or forecast is asserted.
